summary.text: Dunixi Guereca is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 7, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are Government, Military and Veterans Affairs and Transportation and Telecommunications.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Guereca was born October 1, 1988, in Torrance, California, and graduated from Mira Costa High School in 2006.

His biography lists his occupation as nonprofit executive director, with past work as an organizer for the Service Employees International Union and as a business director for the Boy Scouts of America.
It lists membership in the League of United Latin American Citizens, the Sierra Club and Farmers Union, and past service as president of the Nebraska Young Democrats.
